name.ja: アクションベース1 クリア

description.ja: ディスプレイするアイテムを選ばず、どんなシュチュエーションにもマッチする透明なアクションベース登場！ キットを支える支柱は伸縮、方向、角度も調整可能。 キットを取り付けるジョイントパーツは股間用8mm幅、9mm幅、10mm幅に加え、差し込み用、ビス止め用の5種が付属。 台座部は連結が可能、並べて飾るのに最適。
description.en: Introducing a transparent action base that matches any situation, regardless of the item you display! The pillar supporting the Kit can be expanded/contracted, and the direction and angle can be adjusted. Five types of joint parts for attaching the kit are included: 8mm width, 9mm width, and 10mm width for the crotch, as well as one for insertion and one for fixing with screws. The pedestals can be connected, making them ideal for displaying them side by side.
